title: Brazilian Egg Rolls Satay
description: Grassy and juicy Brazilian egg rolls that are satvik-friendly, dehydrated and full of flavor, perfect for a quick indulgence.
instructions: Mix together wheat flour and water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of coconut oil in the center of each circle.
Add 2-3 tablespoons of shredded coconut, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper on top of the oil.
Fold the egg roll into a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the egg rolls for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Dehydrate the egg rolls in a preheated oven at 150°F (65°C) for 30 minutes.
Let the egg rolls cool completely before serving.
